This proposal introduces a new Crewmate role called the Shadow Waker. This role adds a new layer of chaotic gameplay and deception, forcing Impostors and Crewmates alike to think on their feet and adapt to an unpredictable ally.

The New Role: The Shadow Waker
The Shadow Waker is a unique Crewmate who can be killed by the Impostor. Their ultimate goal is still to complete tasks and help the Crewmates win, but they have a suite of abilities that can be used an infinite number of times to cause confusion and aid their team.

Shadow Waker Abilities
Teleportation: The Shadow Waker can teleport to any location within a circle of a customizable radius around them. This allows for quick escapes, surprising arrivals, or fast-paced movement across the map.
Invisibility: The Shadow Waker can become invisible for a very short duration. While invisible, their shadow remains visible and can be seen by other players. This can be enabled or disabled in the host settings.
Shadow Form: The Shadow Waker can take on the form of another player's shadow. This has two sub-options:
Auto-Follow: The Shadow Waker can automatically follow the real player's shadow, moving with them across the map.
Manual Control: The Shadow Waker can move the player's shadow to any location on the map, completely independent of the real player's movements.
MedBay Attach: For a very short time, the Shadow Waker can stick to the back of another player. If that player uses the MedBay body scanning task, the Shadow Waker's weight, color, and other information will be added to the scan results, creating a confusing and misleading report.
How It Changes the Game
The Shadow Waker introduces a new dynamic to every match. Crewmates will now have to consider whether a suspicious action was an Impostor sabotage or simply the work of a mischievous Shadow Waker. Impostors, in turn, can use the chaos created by the Shadow Waker to their advantage, making kills and escapes much easier.
